description: Scheduler-fired EDGE_SINK sibling of audit_retrieval_corpus. Submits the default-corpus retrieval-drift walk to a single-slot background executor and returns a started/already-running receipt immediately; the walk itself (several minutes at ~14s/article) runs on a daemon thread, off the action-queue dispatch path. Terminal action; no result-processor dispatch and no inference scaffold. Cron-only wiring (`is_discoverable=False`); not surfaced via process_search. The model-callable equivalent is service_interface::knowledge_service::audit_retrieval_corpus, which returns the full aggregated report synchronously.
embedding_description: Scheduler cron sibling that fires the corpus-wide retrieval-drift audit as a fast-returning EDGE_SINK terminal action. Operator wiring used by the daily 'KB retrieval drift audit' schedule; returns a started/already-running receipt rather than the audit report itself, because the report takes several minutes to produce and must not park the action queue. The model-callable equivalent is service_interface::knowledge_service::audit_retrieval_corpus.
